transcript.answer: Gemini pods had no Lore MCP tools because the MCP server config was written where gemini-cli would not read it. Subsystem v0.11.2 wrote the config to a system-scope settings file, `/agent/.ai-agent/gemini-settings.json`, which was pointed to by GEMINI_CLI_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH. gemini-cli refused to load that file. It printed "Security Warning: Skipping system settings file ... Parent directory is not owned by root (uid 0). Current uid: 1000". The agent pod runs as uid 1000, so it could not create a root-owned directory. Gemini therefore started with "init … (0 tools)" and made zero MCP calls. The fix came in ai-agent-subsystem #246, released as v0.11.3. Init now merges mcpServers into the gemini-cli user settings file, `/agent/.gemini/settings.json` ($HOME/.gemini/settings.json), using `ai-agent-init mcp-settings`. This was deployed through lore #2144 and proven on 2026-09-23 around 21:20 UTC. A code-review run then made mcp_lore_* tool calls.

judgements.reason: The answer says v0.11.2 wrote MCP config to a system-scope settings file that gemini-cli refused for a uid-1000 directory, and that v0.11.3 moved it to /agent/.gemini/settings.json, which matches the gold answer.
